title: Turkish Chicken Kebabs
description: Use this chicken kebab recipe from Chef John featuring a spicy yogurt-based marinade for juicy and tender grilled chicken skewers all summer long!
ingredients: 2 tablespoons freshly squeezed lemon juice, or more to taste
2.5 pounds boneless, skinless chicken thighs, halved

steps.text: Whisk yogurt, garlic, olive oil, lemon juice, ketchup, red pepper flakes, salt, cumin, black pepper, paprika, and cinnamon together in a large bowl.
Place chicken thigh halves into the yogurt marinade and coat them thoroughly on all sides. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate, 2 to 8 hours.
Preheat an outdoor grill for medium-high heat and lightly oil the grate.
Using 2 skewers for each kebab, thread half of the chicken thighs onto each pair of skewers making a fairly thick "log" shape.

Place kebabs on the preheated grill. Do not try to turn them until they begin to unstick from the grill, 3 or 4 minutes. Turn kebabs and grill the other side for 3 to 4 minutes. Continue cooking and turning until chicken is no longer pink in the center, about 6 minutes more. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).

video.description: In this video, Chef John will show you step-by-step how to make this fabulous chicken kebab dish featuring tons of bold flavors, with not a lot of effort. Chicken thighs are coated in a Turkish spiced yogurt and marinated for a couple hours. Then, he will show you a few tricks for skewering and grilling these up. The results are fantastic; crispy, smoky, spicy flavors with tender, juicy chicken. No frills, and not a lot of experience is needed!
